articles.title: It’s Not Time to Dump Megabank Shares Just Yet
articles.mainIdea: It’s Not Time to Dump Megabank Shares Just Yet
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: It’s Not Time to Dump Megabank Shares Just Yet. Certainly some sticking points for lenders have emerged from Washington early this year. Will President Trump find a way to make good on a pledge to cap credit-card rates? Could the Federal Reserve cut rates even more aggressively than believed this year, further denting banks’ hopes for growth in interest income?
